findings: Task 1 (Mobilise): HRCW marked false but dominant hazard is 'Fall from height' (HRCW-eligible). Should be HRCW=true, cl.2.
Task 3 (Latent condition): HRCW=false correct. Asbestos/lead survey hold-point logic sound. No silica/hazmat undercall.
Task 4 (Remove waterproofing): HRCW=true, cl.2 correct. Silica dominant hazard properly identified. Wet suppression + P2/P3 + dust extraction controls adequate. No silica undercall.

Task 5 (Slab crack): HRCW=true but dominant hazard mismatch. Listed as 'Fall from height' but concrete dust inhalation during breaking is equal/greater hazard. Should prioritise dust control (HEPA extraction + P2/P3) as dominant. Minor undercall of concrete dust severity.
Task 6 (Waterproofing membrane): HRCW=true, CHM-H6 code correct. Chemical exposure hazard properly identified. SDS + ventilation + gloves adequate. No hazmat undercall.
Task 7 (Tiles/render/balustrades): HRCW=true, SIL-H6 correct. Fall dominant hazard appropriate. No silica undercall; wet cutting + dust control specified.
Task 8 (Ground-floor tiles): HRCW=false but slip/trip dominant hazard correct (non-height work). Task properly classified. Anti-slip matting + wet-mop controls adequate.
Task 9 (Suite 7 awning): HRCW=true, WAH-H6 correct. Fall dominant hazard appropriate. Dropped object + harness controls sound.
Task 10 (Defect inspection): HRCW=true, SYS-M3 correct. Fall dominant hazard appropriate. Harness + balustrade check controls sound.
Task 11 (Dismantle scaffold): HRCW=true, WAH-H6 correct. Fall dominant hazard appropriate. Harness + netting removal sequencing sound.
Silica controls (Tasks 4, 7, 8): Wet suppression + P2/P3 + dust extraction specified consistently. No silica overcall or undercall detected.
Hazmat controls (Tasks 3, 6): SDS review + ventilation + gloves specified. Chemical exposure properly managed; no hazmat overcall.
HRCW classification: 1 undercall (Task 1 should be HRCW=true); no overcalls detected.
Dominant hazard logic: Task 5 shows minor concrete dust undercall relative to fall hazard; logic defensible but dust generation during concrete breaking deserves equal emphasis.
Hold points and stop-work triggers present and proportionate across all tasks.
